stages.label: Baskets arrive
stages.narrative: Synthetic household baskets register fractional demand by product and neighborhood.

stages.label: Packages form
stages.narrative: Compatible shares combine into whole warehouse packages under the selected policy.

stages.label: Trips adapt
stages.narrative: Capacity, savings, cold custody, and any stockout, cancellation, or detour determine the recomputed trip plan.

stages.label: Costs settle
stages.narrative: Purchases, supported receipt lines, handoffs, household cost, and unused package units reconcile together.

seeds.label: Weekend neighborhood pool
seeds.description: Modeled demand across four NYC warehouses compares independent shopping, bulk splitting, existing-trip delivery, and pickup hubs.
seeds.missionText: Run the predefined weekend neighborhood bulk-purchasing and existing-trip pooling scenario.

seeds.label: Cold-chain constraint
seeds.description: Refrigerated and frozen requests face tighter cold capacity, detour, stop, and freshness constraints.
seeds.missionText: Run the predefined neighborhood bulk-pool cold-chain constraint scenario.

seeds.label: Compensation choices
seeds.description: Pro-bono, exact-expense, and disclosed-fee trips expose separate cost, burden, and reputation dimensions.
seeds.missionText: Run the predefined neighborhood bulk-pool driver-compensation scenario.

seeds.label: Unknown inventory
seeds.description: Unknown warehouse availability fails closed unless the user explicitly admits it as a scenario assumption.
seeds.missionText: Run the predefined neighborhood bulk-pool unknown-inventory scenario.
